scope_legend.both: dispatcher iterates runState.IterateHookListeners(combatState) (run listeners, plus combat ones when a combat is live)
scope_legend.direct: dispatcher calls the hook on a specific model, no listener iteration
scope_legend.unknown: not called from any Hook.cs dispatcher
